summary.name: Tower
summary.one_liner: Tower is a desktop Git client for Mac and Windows that provides a visual interface for managing Git repositories.
use_cases: rewriting commit history with interactive rebase
working with git submodules and LFS
summary.what_it_does: Tower is a graphical Git client for macOS and Windows. It offers drag-and-drop operations and an undo feature (⌘+Z) for Git actions. It supports pull requests, single-line staging, interactive rebase, and a conflict wizard for resolving merges. It also covers submodules, Git LFS, Git-Flow, file history, blame, and cherry-pick. Additional features listed include stacked branches, worktrees, workflows, quick actions, and automatic stashing and fetching. The page lists AI Commits as a feature but does not describe how it works.
notable: Undo for Git operations (⌘+Z) and drag-and-drop interface
caveats: Pricing and any paid tiers are not stated on the page
Page lists two version numbers (18.0 and 14.1) both released on October 6, 2026, which is unclear
